media:group.media:title: Minecraft Baby Zombie Jockey OMG
media:group.media:description:
Today I was back in the mine trying to find more diamonds. I ran into a lot of crazy things along the way including a baby zombie jockey! I was so excited to finally see one. I also saw other baby zombies and a slime. I ran into all different Minecraft mobs. I didn't find any diamonds but was able to mine a bunch of iron blocks.

media:group.media:title: Minecraft Cave Explorer - Episode 2
media:group.media:description:
Today I head back to the cave where it looked as though I surely was going to die. Instead I happen to find diamonds hidden under some coal. Woohoo. Then I get a ton of iron and craft myself some armor and head out to kill some mobs. I run across everything from spiders, zombies, creepers, skeletons, and even one enderman. Exploring the caves are great and I run across a beautiful waterfall that runs into a lava lake. So of course, there's some obsidian there.

media:group.media:description:

entry.title: BTS: Quake N Bake Minecraft Creeps with ihasCupquake

media:group.media:description:
Went over to Miss ihasCupquake's house and made Creeps (Minecraft creeper peeps) for her show Quake N Bake. They are based on an April Fool's joke that ThinkGeek did a few years ago by making Minecraft creepers look like the easter candy peeps. media:group.media:title: Minecraftchick's Mushroom House
media:group.media:description: Today I decided to build something in Minecraft, which I hardly ever do. I found a beautiful forest with giant mushrooms in it and decided to build a tiny cozy cottage in one of them. It;s the perfect hideout from creepers, zombies, enderman, spiders, and skeletons. I added some windows so that I could see out and wait for daylight. Also made sure to add all the Minecraft essentials for living: workbench, chest, furnace, and bed.

media:group.media:title: Minecraft Dash of Doom
media:group.media:description: Today I went on my Minecraft Realms server and played a special custom map called Dash of Doom. It is a temple run type challenge that was created by Dragnoz (http://www.youtube.com/dragnoz). The aim is to continue moving around obstacles as fast as you can. If you slow down, you start losing health and will eventually die. It was a lot of fun to play this mini game against Vu.
